allowed: Ranks rule-generated candidate metabolites for research prioritization.
Provides evidence overlay for known microbe, enzyme, and literature support.
Supports internal research web-app MVP after readiness validation passes.
not_allowed: Does not prove gut microbial occurrence.
Does not claim complete metabolite generation.
Does not provide consumer health or clinical recommendations.

repository_contract.entrypoint_policy: Reviewer-facing scripts live under scripts/ and wrap matching tools/ implementations; legacy modular/ and src/ code remains in place unless migrated in a dedicated round.

training.current_training_scope: LTR_chem deployment models for modules A/B/C/D using clean_candidates.parquet

next_required_evidence: External head-to-head against BioTransformer, MicrobeRX, and a GutBug-style EC/enzyme baseline.
Generation recall report by module, reaction class, and rule family, expanded with external tool outputs.
Schema and regression tests for known compounds such as rutin.
Model and data version registry binding rules, embeddings, metrics, and model files.
